title: Pattern docs still say a Cmd handler returns Promise<M | void>
rawReport:
## Summary
PR https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/pull/338 (for #324) lets a hand-written Cmd handler return a list of Msgs. Two pattern docs and two code comments still describe the old return shape, one Msg or nothing.

## What I was doing
Reviewing PR https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/pull/338 at head f65d65b. The PR body itself names the pattern-doc drift as a follow-up it left out because those paths are governed.

## What I observed
- `.patterns/tea/tea-discipline.md:247` and `.patterns/tea/elm-canon.md:190` say a handler returns `Promise<M | void>`.
- `src/pure/core.ts:1823` (the injected-dispatch comment) says a leaf handler "returns its follow-up Msg (`Promise<M | void>`)".
- `src/runtime-types.ts:1243` (the `wrapDetached` comment) says a leaf handler "keeps returning `Promise<M | void>`".
After PR 338 the plain cell type is `Promise<M | readonly M[] | void>` on the Promise engine and `Effect<M | readonly M[] | void, unknown, R>` on the Effect engine.

## Why it matters
An agent reads `.patterns/` before writing code and is told to trust it over memory. It will keep writing wrappers that dispatch a list by hand, which is the glue #324 set out to remove.

## Pointers
- `.patterns/tea/tea-discipline.md:247`, `.patterns/tea/elm-canon.md:190`
- `src/pure/core.ts:1823`, `src/runtime-types.ts:1243`
- #324, PR https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/pull/338, ruling R10.1 in #325

## Suggested next step (non-binding)
Update the four spots to name the list form, and point at Elm's `Cmd.batch` as the analogue, the way the PR's how-to lines do.

enriched:
## Summary

Two "Tuval on tea" changes landed, but four `.patterns/tea` docs and two code comments still describe the old behaviour. Agents read `.patterns/` before writing code and trust it over memory, so the stale text steers campaign #2 work toward the glue those changes removed.

- **#324 (PR https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/pull/338):** a hand-written Cmd handler may return a list of Msgs. The cell type is now `Promise<M | readonly M[] | void>` (`packages/tea/src/pure/core.ts`, `packages/tea/src/testing/drive.ts`) and `Effect.Effect<M | readonly M[] | void, unknown, R>` (`packages/tea/src/effect/run.ts`).
- **#316 (PR https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/pull/351):** `migrate` returns `Migrated<S> = S | null | Refusal` (`packages/tea/src/runtime-types.ts`). `null` means nothing was saved. A `refuse(reason)`, or a throw from `load`/`migrate`, raises `StoreRefusedError` and writes nothing (`packages/tea/src/internal/engine/restore.ts`). Unreadable bytes no longer boot fresh.

Triage note: every stale spot below was read at `origin/main` on 2026-09-24. Line numbers are from that read. The `runtime-types.ts` comment has moved from the reported line 1243 to line 1332.

## Stale spots

| File | What it says now |
|---|---|
| `.patterns/tea/tea-discipline.md` (~L247) | Cmd handlers "can return `Promise<M \| void>`" |
| `.patterns/tea/elm-canon.md` (~L190) | `interpret` map typed `(cmd, ctx) => Promise<M \| void>` |
| `packages/tea/src/pure/core.ts` (~L1823) | injected-dispatch comment: leaf handler "returns its follow-up Msg (`Promise<M \| void>`)" |
| `packages/tea/src/runtime-types.ts` (~L1332) | `wrapDetached` comment: leaf handler "keeps returning `Promise<M \| void>`" |
| `.patterns/tea/patterns/08-typescript-tax.md` (§2, ~L35-41) | `migrate(raw: unknown): S \| null`, "`null` on unrecognized (boots fresh). Must not throw." |
| `.patterns/tea/tea-invariants.md` (~L368, "Enforcement today") | says `migrate(raw)` parses at the boundary but never mentions the refusal path. Triage note: this one is incomplete, not wrong. Add the refusal clause. Don't rewrite the section. |

Searched the board for an open ticket that owns `.patterns/tea` drift (two dedup queries: the Msg-list wording, and migrate/null/refuse). Nothing matched, so this stays standalone.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.patterns/tea/tea-discipline.md` and `.patterns/tea/elm-canon.md` name the handler return as `Promise<M | readonly M[] | void>` (and the Effect-engine form where the doc covers it), and point to Elm's `Cmd.batch` as the analogue of returning a list.
- [ ] The comments in `packages/tea/src/pure/core.ts` (injected `dispatch`) and `packages/tea/src/runtime-types.ts` (`wrapDetached`) name the list form, not `Promise<M | void>`.
- [ ] `.patterns/tea/patterns/08-typescript-tax.md` §2 shows `migrate` returning `Migrated<S>` (`S | null | Refusal`), says `null` means nothing saved, and says a `refuse(reason)` or a throw refuses with `StoreRefusedError` and writes nothing. It no longer says unrecognized input boots fresh or that `migrate` must not throw.
- [ ] `.patterns/tea/tea-invariants.md` "Enforcement today" mentions that `migrate` can refuse, and that a refusal writes nothing.
- [ ] `git grep -n 'M | void' -- .patterns packages/tea/src` returns no prose or comment that still states the old handler return shape.
- [ ] The `.patterns/` edits go through the `write-pattern` skill, and each changed claim matches the source file it cites.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` pass.

### No-gos

- No behaviour or type changes. Comments and docs only.
- Don't touch `docs/reference/`. It's generated.
